title: PLAYBOY Magazine March 1988 Complete With Centerfold Susie Diane Owens
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy Magazine from March 1988, featuring a centerfold of Susie Diane Owens. This magazine, in English and published monthly, covers a variety of genres including women's interests, art & photography, and men's topics such as photography, art, and modeling. With a focus on the cultural and entertainment aspects of the era, this magazine provides a unique glimpse into the lifestyle and preferences of its target audience from the late 1980s.
